author: Priya Ndiaye, fleet engineering
notes: First cut of the board note off the returns to October. Ran it as it stands.
Delia wants the 2022-H2 build against 2021-H2 and a number she can put to procurement.
Register has 1,711 vans on it across thirty-three build months. Log has faults back to April 2022.

Roster and register do not give the same monthly count. Roster is higher every month of the window; October reads 1,626 against 1,450 vans with a hand-over date on or before the first and a hand-back date on or after it.
